caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a metal rooster weathervane, shown in profile facing to the right. The rooster has an arched tail, a prominent comb, and a pointed beak, with detailed feather patterns etched into its body, wings, and tail. The metal surface is rendered with shades of brown, green, and hints of reddish tones, suggesting a patina typically found on aged copper or bronze objects. The rooster stands on a horizontal bar supported by a vertical rod, both of which are also colored in muted brown to match the rooster. The background is an off-white or very light beige with no additional elements or distractions, making the rooster and its supporting bar the sole focus of the composition. The artist's name, "Maurice Blumenfeld," is written in small letters in the lower left corner.
title: Weather Vane Finial
